_comment: Copy to local.config.json (gitignored) and edit. Absent or empty is fine — the managed-doc render and project-hook validation simply no-op. Set push to false on machines that must never push (e.g. a corporate laptop); commits stay local.
_windows_corporate_note: On a locked-down Windows machine: set link_mode to 'copy' (symlinks denied by group policy) and push to false. Run ai-sync from Git Bash. python3 and python are both tried automatically by hook scripts.
